اذدكروا (form VIII)
# اِذْدَكَرُوا (iḏdakarū) /ið.da.ka.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِذْدَكَرَ (iḏdakara)
# اُذْدُكِرُوا (uḏdukirū) /uð.du.ki.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِذْدَكَرَ (iḏdakara)
# اِذْدَكِرُوا (iḏdakirū) /ið.da.ki.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِذْدَكَرَ (iḏdakara)
